grid.sampling: every 19th MOLA cell in each direction (exact values, not averaged)

source.dataset: Mars MGS MOLA DEM 463m (MEGDR derived mosaic)

resolution.statement: Source grid spacing is 8799 m. Boulders, dunes, small craters, ripples and rover-scale slopes (<~1 km) are NOT resolved; slopes are averaged over ~1.4 km. Terrain-evaluated is not mission-safe.

routes.objective: Minimise geometric length (great circle). No terrain optimisation.

resolution.statement: Source grid spacing is 8799 m. Boulders, dunes, small craters, ripples and rover-scale slopes (<~1 km) are NOT resolved; slopes are averaged over ~1.4 km. Terrain-evaluated is not mission-safe.

routes.objective: Minimise d·(1+(slope/slope_ref)²) with hard slope cap (cross-slope proxy = Horn slope at 463 m).

notes: Display product of the long-range grid (block mean for display only).

limitations: Strategic overview: elevations are real MOLA values sampled every few kilometres (see grid spacing), not the full 463 m grid.
At this spacing slopes are smoothed out: steep crater walls, scarps and every obstacle smaller than the spacing are invisible.
Travel time, sols and consumables are estimates from editable assumptions; multi-sol operations (recharging, night, rest, resupply) are not modelled.
Not a route a crew could follow. Plan each leg locally (≤ ~150 km) for terrain-evaluated detail. Nothing here is certified.
